name: Windvigil Angler Gull
desc: A medium-sized bird native to Mondstadt, distinguished by gray-white and golden feathers.\nThough their flight may appear aimless, Windvigil Angler Gulls often follow routes that mirror ancient sea lanes. Carried by seasonal winds and ocean currents, they arrive ahead of approaching vessels, as if sensing distant movement long before sails are raised. Sailors at Dornman Port therefore consider their presence a favorable omen.\nIn sea shanties passed down through generations, they are described as messengers between the sea and the sky. Wherever gulls gather, new faces and new stories are not far behind.
